content: For structured, multi-tenant, RBAC-heavy backend platforms, NestJS (TS) is recommended over Express for larger/longer-lived codebases due to DI, modules, and guards; Fastify adapter available for performance. FastAPI recommended only if team wants Python. Comparable self-hosted platform Docmost (NestJS+Fastify+Kysely+Postgres+React+Vite+Mantine+Tiptap+Redis, pnpm+NX monorepo) is a strong architectural precedent for this exact problem shape.
